senses.gloss: concretion, glebe, or alluvial mound.—Pl. כָּתִין, כַּתִּין, with suffix (כַּתָּהָא) כָּתָהָא.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 14:19">Targ. Job XIV, 19</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 37:30">Targ. Is. XXXVII, 30</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 19:29">Targ. II Kings XIX, 29</cite>.

Targ. Lev. XXV, 5 (some ed. O. sing., v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 38). Ib. 11 כָּתָהָא ed. Berl. (oth. כַּתָּ׳; Y. כַּאֲוָותָהָא, some ed. בַּ׳, perh. to be read: כַּתְוָותָהָא).—[Sabb. 110ᵇ מכבתותא דמישרי, perh. מכַּתְוָותָא of the after-crop of valleys, v. בַּתְוָא].—כָּתְכָּתִין, כַּתְכַּתִּין third crop. Targ. Is. l. c.; Targ. II Kings l. c. (h. text שחיס, סחיש).
